_doc: Per-harness capability descriptor. capability-probe.mjs reads this to determine which capabilities each harness should probe and which per-harness probe script implements each row. Schema lives at sibling row-schema.md per DC-98 (schema-consumer coupling). Per-harness probe scripts are responsible for emitting full capability rows matching the schema.

claude-code._doc: Partly empirical — anti-anchoring claim still trust-based (R-17 DEGRADED-by-mechanism per session 48). v2.8.0 physical staging closes R-17.

codex._doc: Empirical — Codex side is the canonical anti-anchoring target. Probe must produce real evidence rows, not trust-claims.

gemini._doc: Scaffolding-only — no empirical Codex/Claude-equivalent probes yet. Descriptor entry reserves the slot for v2.7.0+ work.

consumer_actions._doc: Named pre-action gates. Each lists the capability_ids it requires in PASS state before the action proceeds.

project-memory-write.description: Autonomous write to <project>/_memories/ or PROJECT.md outside the user's session turn
